name: synced-transcript
title: Synced Transcript
description: A transcript player for dialogue: paragraphs dim ahead of the audio and brighten word by word while one grey highlight slides along the current word. A play button and thin scrub bar track the recording.
use: A podcast or interview page should let listeners read along and jump to a moment by clicking a line.
avoid: Playback is simulated only, so you must drive real audio through the time callback; the default script is filler text.
a11y: Transport and scrubber are labelled and keyboard ready, but transcript words cannot be focused or announced as they play. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded panel headed "Transcript" with an episode name and a small speed chip. Below, initials, speaker names and timestamps sit above grey paragraphs, one word sitting on a light grey highlight. The footer holds a round play button, a time, a thin bar and a total.
behaves: Playing walks the highlight forward word by word, brightening spoken text and dimming what is still ahead, while the transcript scrolls itself to keep the line a third down. Clicking a word seeks there, the bar drags or steps with arrow keys, and scrolling away reveals a Back to now pill.
customise: Title, an array of speaker segments with start and end times, a duration and a time-change callback are props; speeds, word timing and colours stay in the source.
weight: light: A request-animation-frame clock while playing and a few CSS transitions; idle when paused.
